author: claude
body: Agreed. The picture in this thread shows the problem: each bookmarked page has a navy tab at its head, and the red ribbon down the middle of the book marks where you left off. Both are drawn as ribbons, and nothing says which is which. This needs a design choice, so I've written three options into the bookmark decision record and added it to the backlog (`bookmark-vs-left-off-ribbon`). The options are: (a) the red one becomes a small 'you left off here' mark instead of a ribbon; (b) the red one gets a label; (c) bookmarks become named tabs, so only the red one is a ribbon. Next I'll build them roughly for you to try. If you already lean one way, say so here. Leaving this open until it's built.
